answer: Before any cart crosses the bridge, the keeper counts its wheels and writes the count on the post. Proof of soap boiler vat via lye strength test is the counting: a batch the boiler cuts only after the lye tests 3 strengths, each tested with an egg that floats true. The crystal is the first wheel, counted at the near end; the ridge is the last, counted at the far end; the spiral is the post itself, which still shows no cart under his name. A cheat must count 43 false wheels and write 43 false posts.
